metadata.name: mango-oracle-pump
metadata.description: Oracle-pump bad-debt pressure replay against the shipped Solana lending fork. The pump-trader deposits 100 collateral while the oracle is at the pre-pump price (100). At tick 1 the oracle pumps to 500 and the pump-trader borrows 35000 against the inflated collateral (healthy under the inflated regime: 100*500*0.8/35000 ~ 11428 bps health factor). At tick 2 the oracle reverts to 100 — the position is deeply underwater (~ 2285 bps). The liquidator-0 settles at tick 2; seized collateral is far below repay+bonus value, so bad debt accrues at the pool level and the oracle_bounds invariant fires. Historical inspiration: the October 2022 Mango Markets exploit (~$116M), where MNGO/USDC perp price was pumped via self-trades on a thin order book and the manipulator borrowed against an oracle-followed inflated price before the price reverted. Honest boundary: economic-shape replay on Riptide's Solend-fork toy lending program, NOT a byte-level reconstruction of Mango v3's program or slot state.
